summary.text: Brian Adams is a Republican from Berkeley County who represents Senate District 44 (Berkeley and Charleston Counties) in the South Carolina Senate and serves on the Corrections and Penology, Family and Veterans' Services, Fish, Game and Forestry, Judiciary and Transportation committees.

paragraphs.text: Adams is a retired police officer and co-owner of Tri-County Appraisals; he was born December 27, 1969, in Mt. Clemens, Michigan, and graduated from Stratford High School in 1989.
His page lists his police career as sergeant over detectives at NCPD in 2008, lieutenant over specialized units in 2016, and lieutenant over School Resource Officers in 2018.
He also served on the board of the Law Enforcement Coordinating Committee beginning in 2016.
